name: Count-up
one_line: A figure that runs up or down to its value: a statistic landing, a timer, hours elapsed
summary: A displayed figure runs from a starting value to the true one and then rests, or tracks a clock as a countdown or elapsed time. It adds anticipation to a statistic and shows time passing in a readout. The landing must show exactly the stated value, the figures must not shift sideways as digits change, and the count must not pass its target on the way.

routes.one_line: Interpolate the value from t and draw it as text on a 2D canvas

steps.does: Compute the displayed value from t, round it, and draw it as text each seek

limits: Evidence shows a changing time readout, not a count that lands on a data value
No OpenType feature control, so tabular figures depend on the font chosen

routes.one_line: Tween a number object on a seekable timeline and write it to the page

steps.does: Tween a plain value on a paused timeline and write the rounded result to text each seek

limits: Anime.js evidence covers transform, SVG draw and stagger, not tweening a number into text
Nothing in the tool stops an easing from passing the target; the cited data rules still apply

routes.one_line: Drive the figure from a data scale and interpolator beside a chart

steps.does: Interpolate between values with a scale driven from t, shared with the chart

limits: D3 evidence interpolates chart values, not a displayed numeral
Text drawing is outside this step; pair it with an SVG or DOM text step
